features.title: Persistent Google Login and Auth Session Support
features.note: Re-evaluated on the Qt app 2026-11-17: persistent profile, forced persistent cookies, Chrome UA and the chrome.app shim. A cookie set by a test page was found on disk with is_persistent=1 after a clean quit. The Google sign-in flow itself is not verified.

features.title: Deterministic UI Design and Navigation Polish
features.note: Re-evaluated on the Qt app 2026-11-17: theme colours read through Omarchy's alias keys and derived WCAG AA ink, 0 text-pair failures across 24 themes, keyboard reach and focus return verified, qmllint clean.

features.title: Tab Session State Restore on Restart
features.note: session.json written 500 ms after any tab change and on close (0600); restored on start when no URLs were passed. Ctrl+Q asks first when more than three tabs are open.
